title: Rabbi David Tawil: Pesah 2022- "Sacrifice for Hashem"

chapters.title: The Parable of the Messenger
chapters.about: A story illustrating the importance of following Hashem's will.

chapters.title: Raban Gamaliel on God's Will
chapters.about: The Mishna in Pirket Avot regarding aligning our will with Hashem's.

chapters.title: The Mitzva of Tzedaka
chapters.about: Giving charity as a form of sacrifice and a path to blessing.

chapters.title: Sacrifice as the Core of Judaism
chapters.about: Defining the role of sacrifice in building relationships and character.

chapters.title: Pesah and Preparation
chapters.about: The effort and sacrifice involved in preparing for the holiday.

chapters.title: Identity and Korbanot
chapters.about: The connection between Bri Mila, Korban Pesah, and Jewish identity.

chapters.title: Support in Sacrifice
chapters.about: The need for support when performing difficult Mitzvot.

summary: Rabbi Tawil discusses the concept of sacrifice as the foundation for building a close, loving relationship with Hashem. He explains that by negating our own will in favor of Hashem's will, we grow through the challenges and efforts required by the Mitzvot, particularly during the holiday of Pesah.
questions: How does sacrificing for Hashem help build a closer relationship with Him?
Why is the holiday of Pesah considered a time of sacrifice?
What is the connection between Bri Mila and Korban Pesah?
How can we maintain the spirit of the holiday when traveling?
